resources.string: Six contracts to bring the forge to life. Match metals, clear slag and deliver the energy core. No timer.

Swap two neighbouring pieces to align at least three identical metals. Swipe, or tap two pieces.\n\nTilt your phone to direct falling pieces, even during cascades. The board stays fixed; pieces fall towards physical down.
Match the requested metal. Only successful swaps cost a move; cascades are free.
Match pieces on the scratched brown cells to clean them.
Bring the core to the turquoise edge. Clear pieces in its path and tilt the device to direct the falls.
Well forged. All cascades have been resolved.
Try this same contract again with a different approach.
No moves available: metals reshuffled for free.
Forge board. Swipe a metal towards a neighbour or tap two neighbouring pieces.
Cascade in progress… Moving pieces cannot be swapped yet.
Swipe queued for the end of the cascade.
This swap does not match three metals. No move spent.
These pieces moved during the cascade. Swipe again at their new position.
